reply.text:
I'll take the hard session side of this, but not the "pain is weakness leaving the body" part. Hard training means work that is challenging and within your control, not pushing through anything that hurts. If something hurts sharply or feels wrong, that is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I'd stop there.

If you want a hard session, tell me what you're after: a particular lift, how much time you have, and what equipment you're working with. I can build it through the app's session builder, and you can tell me what to avoid if anything is bothering you.
